findings.title: Planboard task completion can show another project's cards and start the wrong issue
findings.body:
Starting a task in project A and switching to project B before it completes can replace B's board with A's cards. Clicking a stale card then dispatches its issue number against B. This can start an unrelated issue when the same number exists there.

### Reproduced
Mounted the real PlanboardView with deferred callbacks:
1. Project A shows issue #11. Click Start task and leave its promise pending.
2. Select project B; its issue #22 appears.
3. Resolve A's start successfully.
4. Project selector still says B, but the board shows A/#11.
5. Clicking #11 passes `{projectId:"b",projectPath:"/tmp/audit-b",ref:"11"}` to onStartTask.

No real agent was launched. Runnable assertion: `node --import=./test/support/disable-grok-mcp.mjs --import=./test/support/render.mjs --experimental-strip-types docs/issue-drafts/2026-09-08-view-actions-evidence.mjs`.

### Cause and bounded fix
[PlanboardView.tsx](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/components/PlanboardView.tsx#L118) guards loads by invocation generation, but startTask retains A's load closure. Its post-await `void load()` runs after B's load and becomes the newest generation. Rendered cards then use the currently selected project's action context. [App.tsx](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/App.tsx#L1023) fetches the issue using that passed project path/ref.

Bind request results and task completion to the owning project/selection lifetime. An A completion must not refresh or overwrite B. Ensure a card's action project always matches the card's data. Reuse the existing generation guard; no new global state layer.

### Acceptance
- Deferred A start followed by A→B leaves B's cards, notes and pending state intact when A settles.
- The same holds for failure, A→B→A, and removed projects.
- Every Start task call uses the project that owns the displayed issue.
- A successful A task is still recorded; switching does not cancel real work.
- Add the deferred-promise regression covering the reproduced wrong-project call.

### Duplicate check
#942 concerns returning from a thread with navigation state; #945 is Planboard search. Neither addresses a stale task completion overwriting another project's data or dispatching mismatched project/issue pairs. Separate from the rejected-promise recovery finding in this audit.

Audited at 6c7a6fb; PlanboardView's blob also matched the current default branch during verification. Parent audit #1130.

findings.title: Rejected PR and Planboard requests leave loading and Start task controls stuck
findings.body:
A rejected request can permanently disable Refresh or Start task until the view remounts. One project's failed PR request also hides successful results from other projects, and the optional PR meter can prevent an otherwise successful Planboard issue load.

### Reproduced
Mounted real components with deferred promises:
- PrListView: one listPrs rejection leaves “Loading pull requests”, Refresh disabled, no result rows and no visible error, even though another project's request succeeded.
- PlanboardView: listIssues succeeds but optional listPrs rejects; no issue cards appear and Refresh stays disabled.
- PlanboardView: onStartTask rejects; Start controls stay disabled with no failure note.
All three emit unhandled rejections. Runnable assertion: `node --import=./test/support/disable-grok-mcp.mjs --import=./test/support/render.mjs --experimental-strip-types docs/issue-drafts/2026-09-08-view-actions-evidence.mjs`.

### Cause
[PrListView.tsx](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/components/PrListView.tsx#L59) and [PlanboardView.tsx](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/components/PlanboardView.tsx#L118) await Promise.all without catch/finally. Planboard startTask similarly never clears starting after a rejection. PR retry/checkout should be checked under the same rejection contract.

This is specifically the rejected transport/callback boundary. Ordinary gh authentication, missing binary and CLI failures are already normalized to `{ok:false,reason}` by worktrees.js; those alone do not reproduce it. [wireClient.ts](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/wireClient.ts) rejects on request timeout/disconnection. [useCoder.ts](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/useCoder.ts#L2778) forwards list calls. App's issue-start callback also has awaited operations outside its catch.

### Acceptance
- Catch rejected list and action callbacks, render a scoped error, and clear pending flags for the current request in finally.
- Keep successful per-project PR results visible when a sibling fails; support retry of the failed repository.
- Optional PR meter failure must not hide successfully fetched Planboard cards.
- Start failure restores usable controls and explains the failure. Do not automatically retry a potentially applied mutation after an ambiguous timeout.
- Preserve existing structured-error behavior and generation guards, including project changes during failures.
- Add focused rejection checks for initial load, refresh, retry and Start task.

### Duplicate check
#427 proposes forge-outage caching, offline dispatch and replay queues. This is a concrete existing UI recovery defect and can be fixed independently without any offline cache or replay system; link it as a prerequisite. #928 is reconnect write coalescing; #929 is transcript resync. Neither clears these view request flags. The Planboard cross-project completion race is separate.

Parent audit #1130. Audited components match the current default branch blobs.

findings.title: Usage erases its report and Fleet hides failures when refresh requests reject
findings.body:
Refreshing Usage after a successful load can replace real spending with “No usage” when the request fails. Fleet retains its old report but hides the failure, making stale data look refreshed.

### Reproduced
Mounted the real views with a successful response followed by a rejected refresh:
- Usage initially displays a $12.50 fixture report. After failure the amount disappears, “No usage” appears, and there is no error alert.
- Fleet initially displays a nonempty evidence report. After failure that report remains, but neither the error nor a stale-data warning is visible.
Runnable assertion: `node --import=./test/support/disable-grok-mcp.mjs --import=./test/support/render.mjs --experimental-strip-types docs/issue-drafts/2026-09-08-view-actions-evidence.mjs`. The amount is synthetic test data, not user billing.

### Cause and minimal fix
[UsageView.tsx](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/components/UsageView.tsx#L119) catches failed loads by replacing report state with EMPTY_REPORT and has no error state. [FleetView.tsx](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/components/FleetView.tsx#L303) retains evidence and sets error, but only renders that error in the empty-report branch. [InsightsView.tsx](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/components/InsightsView.tsx) already demonstrates rendering an error alongside existing data; reuse that pattern.

### Acceptance
- Preserve the last successful report after a failed refresh, with a visible accessible error and stale/last-success indication.
- Initial failure shows an error with retry, distinct from a successfully loaded empty report.
- Successful retry clears the failure/stale indication and updates the report.
- Retain the selected reporting range/metric; changing scope must not present another scope's old data as current.
- Loading controls recover on failure. Never fabricate zero spend from a rejected request.
- Add focused initial-failure and success→failure→success checks for both views.

### Duplicate check
#943 explicitly covers Activity and Digest. These are different view owners with two separately reproduced failures, including destructive replacement of Usage report state. #899 concerns provider quota freshness; #946 concerns Usage thread drilldown; #556 concerns accounting values. This issue changes refresh presentation and recovery, not accounting or provider quota collection.

Parent audit #1130. Audited at 6c7a6fb; UsageView and FleetView blobs matched the default branch during verification.

findings.title: Make the PR view searchable and expose open PRs beyond its silent 50-row limit
findings.body:
The PR view requires manual scanning across every project and silently omits open PRs beyond the first 50 per repository. A user cannot find a known older PR or tell that the list is incomplete.

### Evidence
[PrListView.tsx](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/components/PrListView.tsx) renders Refresh and repository groups, with no search or project filter. A mounted component assertion confirms there is no searchbox or select.

[worktrees.js:listPrsRaw](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/electron/worktrees.js#L2864) defaults to `--limit 50`. listPrs uses that default and returns only `{ok:true,prs}`; there is no completeness/continuation metadata. The view offers no Load more action or partial-result notice.

Runnable boundary reproduction:
`node docs/issue-drafts/2026-09-08-pr-list-limit-evidence.cjs`
Uses real listPrs, a fake GitHub origin and fake gh with 75 PRs. Asserts the actual CLI invocation requests 50 and the result contains 50 with no completeness metadata. No GitHub calls.
Mounted controls check: `node --import=./test/support/disable-grok-mcp.mjs --import=./test/support/render.mjs --experimental-strip-types docs/issue-drafts/2026-09-08-view-actions-evidence.mjs`.

### Proposed view improvement
Add a compact native search field for PR number/title/branch and a project filter. Keep existing compact rows, draft badges, Open, Check out and associated-thread navigation. Expose bounded pagination or explicit Load more per repository; report loaded/partial scope honestly. Do not claim a local search covered all open PRs when only a subset was loaded.

### Acceptance
- A known PR can be located by #number, title or branch; project scope narrows results with a clear reset and result count.
- A repository with >50 open PRs exposes a way to reach remaining PRs and clearly indicates partial loading.
- Search on partially loaded data is labelled honestly or searches beyond the loaded subset.
- No-match, empty repository, loading and per-repository failure states are distinct.
- Native keyboard/focus behavior works; existing row actions and matching threads remain intact.
- Use existing grouping/matching helpers. Keep requests bounded and preserve explicit listPrsRaw limits used by other callers such as Fleet.
- Verify a multi-project fixture with >50 PRs, a known PR beyond the first batch, a failed repository and keyboard use.

### Duplicate check
#260 proposes a wider agent-PR attention inbox with prioritization and CI/review signals. This is a bounded browsing foundation for today's all-open-PR view, not that new triage product. #729 covers chrome flattening; #945 adds Planboard search; #942 owns return-navigation state. Link those instead of expanding this issue into their scopes.

Parent audit #1130. PrListView blob matched current default branch during verification.
